purpose: User-authorized aggressive official-data-only optimization after v68

selection.method: Forward per-task rank/value blends starting from frozen v68; sources shared/gated neural, four kernel variants, descriptor/hybrid CatBoost. Soft objective rather than hard fresh-split veto. Development query labels also choose tree stopping iterations.

final_iterations: Median best tree count across 3 scaffold folds and official valid; refit train+valid without test labels using two seeds
limitations: Official valid is now explicitly used for tuning, superseding report-only use for v67/v68 in this new version only.
All development metrics, early stopping and mixture selection are optimistic estimates, not independent generalization measurements.
A new platform score is needed to establish improvement over v63 or v68.
Original v67/v68 files and source signatures remain frozen.
